catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class binds this Trigger reset. cap.world.reset.v1 requires an observation and a seed in its output and accepts scenario, seed and options as input; the pinned /mujoco/reset request and response are std_srvs/Trigger with only success and message, and reset_robot does not seed a random number generator. The extension records the actual wire contract without inventing a seed or an observation.

No catalogue class observes a raw mujoco_msgs/ObjectStateArray on a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 binds the sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque kinds and returns a values map with sampled_at; it does not bind a MuJoCo body-state array.

No catalogue class observes a raw sensor_msgs/JointState for a world.sim resource. cap.sensing.read.v1 does not bind world.sim and does not carry the JointState name, position, velocity and effort arrays.

notes:
BLOCKED (HELPER_MISSING): the pinned node exposes an effectful /mujoco/reset service but no acknowledged pause, stop or e-stop, and no available helper can turn the reset acknowledgement into a confirmed safe state. The reset callback stops running effort controllers, calls reset_robot, sleeps 100 model timesteps, sets response.success from an error_sum threshold and then restarts the controllers it stopped (src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:779-856). reset_robot writes robot joint qpos from joint_inits or zero, zeroes joint qvel/qacc and odometry velocities, and calls mj_forward (src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:569-609); it never stops the independent simulation thread, which keeps calling mj_step1/mj_step2 (src/mj_main.cpp:76-164) on its own thread (src/mj_main.cpp:198-203). The four advertised services are /mujoco/screenshot, /mujoco/reset, /mujoco/spawn_objects and /mujoco/destroy_objects (src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:537-546); no pause, stop, abort or e-stop service exists. A rosbridge topic publication is transmission-only, and a zero-velocity /cmd_vel publication is not an acknowledged stop. RosBridge therefore reports an effectful ROS profile without a stop as an unconfirmed safe state; the stock e-stop returned status failed with MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED (estop 'engaged', expected engaged or software_only) and kept the latch engaged. The recording fake cannot make that stop exist, so this package is not served as a completed control integration.

SCOPE SERVED: the package is a configuration-only ROS 1 RosDriver (mode simulated, risk R0, device_kind world.sim, no Python native class). It binds /mujoco/reset as x-cap.hoanggiang93.reset.v1 with type std_srvs/Trigger (source ref src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:540, type ref include/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.h:36, application success on values.success == true), /mujoco/object_states as x-cap.hoanggiang93.object_states.v1 with mujoco_msgs/ObjectStateArray (src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:560), and /mujoco/robot_joint_states as x-cap.hoanggiang93.robot_joint_states.v1 with sensor_msgs/JointState (src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:561). The shipped src/config/robot.yaml:74-83 sets every object-state and joint-state publisher rate to 0.0, and each publisher returns immediately below 1E-9 (src/mujoco_sim/mj_ros.cpp:1770-1773 and 1812-1815), so a live deployment must set the relevant pub_object_state_array or pub_joint_states rate above zero before either observation can receive a fresh sample; the fake always answers. The reset callback also checks only error_sum and restarts controllers, so its acknowledgement is not sensed quiescence.

CATALOGUE DEVIATIONS: cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 cannot bind this ROS surface because the clone exposes no step or seed endpoint; the simulation steps continuously and there is no RNG seed parameter. cap.world.reset.v1 is not used because its required observation and seed outputs cannot be produced by a std_srvs/Trigger service and no seed is accepted or stored; the x-cap preserves the real contract.

NOT COVERED: /mujoco/screenshot, /mujoco/spawn_objects, /mujoco/destroy_objects, the per-robot /<robot>/cmd_vel input, TF, marker arrays, base-pose odometry, /mujoco/sensors_3D, world stepping, RNG seeding, and every ros_control controller interface. The clone's message definitions for mujoco_msgs are outside this package, so only the two advertised observation topics are mapped.

FAKE/FIDELITY: the deployed fake is a package-local ROS-free RecordingRosTransport (analytic:ROS recording fake (no physics)), F0, determinism none, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0, reset none, no snapshot/restore. It answers only the three declared operations; its reset increments a counter and returns a placeholder Trigger response, and its object/joint samples are placeholders whose real sizes and names are scene-dependent. The gaps also disclose that it does not reset mjData, restart controllers, run MuJoCo or pace wall time. No hardware, ROS graph, rosbridge connection, simulator process or upstream execution was used; no network or pip install was used; the clone was left unmodified (G1 passed). driver.lock.json keeps authored_by model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run ros-wave-c-028) and reviewed_by null; no human review or testing is claimed. test_driver.py keeps check_driver and has ten package-specific cases; the gate case asserts an empty failed list, so it will keep failing while the G6 blocker remains, and G9 was not run because G6 failed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Confirmed the author's block: the pinned node advertises only /mujoco/screenshot, /mujoco/reset, /mujoco/spawn_objects and /mujoco/destroy_objects (mj_ros.cpp:537-546), the reset callback stops and restarts the effort controllers around reset_robot and answers from an error_sum threshold (779-856), and the simulate loop steps continuously on its own thread with no pause branch (mj_main.cpp:76-164, 203), so no acknowledged stop exists and the stock e-stop fails G6.ESTOP_FAILED with the latch held, which is the honest outcome. Endpoints and types (absolute names, Trigger request {}), the fake and the ten package cases were checked; two facts said more than their lines (the thread fact claimed 'waits for ROS shutdown', which is on line 223 and only in the non-VISUAL build, and the cmd_vel fact described a callback at 193-200 while citing 522-533). For whoever unblocks: reset_robot replaces d with a fresh mj_makeData without freeing the old mjData (mj_ros.cpp:571); the reset callback makes two controller_manager calls and sleeps 100 timesteps (at most 0.5 s at max_time_step 0.005, src/config/robot.yaml:56), close to the bridge's 2 s default service timeout; /mujoco/object_states mixes robot, world and spawned-object arrays on one topic; the shipped publisher rates are 0, so both observations time out until a deployment raises them.
